name: Lapis Chinese
description: Mandarin Chinese adaptation of the Lapis Anki note type, with Pinyin and Simplified and Traditional character support.
features: Ready-to-import APKG with an example deck
Persistent Simplified and Traditional character conversion
Vocabulary, sentence, audio, click, and combined card modes

name: moegirl-yomitan
description: Build a Yomitan term dictionary from public Moegirlpedia (萌娘百科) lead summaries. Automated weekly builds via GitHub Actions.
features: CLI with configurable batch size and concurrency

name: CalibreAnalyzer
description: Calibre plugin for analyzing Chinese books by character or word, with HSK coverage, optional Anki comparison, and bundled offline word segmentation runtimes.
features: Character and word frequency analysis for Chinese books
HSK coverage breakdowns and word-length statistics
Optional Anki comparison for known words or characters
Auto-versioned GitHub releases on every push to main
